scored_papers.title: Fully-connected three-mode squeezed vacuum: Gaussian entanglement, steering, and collective photon subtraction
scored_papers.abstract: We investigate the fully-connected three-mode squeezed vacuum state with K_3 topology where each pair of modes is pairwise nonlinearly coupled. Using IWOP technique we derive the covariance matrix and Wigner function analytically.
scored_papers.reason: 全結合K₃トポロジーの三モード圧搾真空を完全解析📐pairwise entangledでも2モード間Gaussian steeringがゼロというユニークな性質
scored_papers.summary: IWOP法で共分散行列を解析的に導出。二モード間steeringは不在でone-to-two collective steeringが本質的資源、損失臨界値η≈0.58も算出
